seo_title: Video Production in Derbyshire | Zen Visuals, Belper
seo_description: Adverts, promo films, product photography and event coverage for businesses, from Belper, Derbyshire. Every brief quoted per project.
hero_alt: Workshop light reflected along the curve of a classic car
intro: We make adverts, promotional films, product photography and corporate event coverage for businesses in Derbyshire and across the UK. Every project is built around one question: what do you need people to feel and do after watching?
We're Zuzia and Ben, a small photo and video team based in Belper, and you'll talk to us directly from the first call to the final film.

sections.heading: Promo films and adverts
sections.text: For Biff's Detailing we filmed a restored 1967 Volkswagen Beetle, from the detailing in the workshop to the finished car out on the road. For watercolour artist Katie Jobling we made a brand film in her studio, showing her process from the first brush stroke to the finished painting.

sections.heading: Explainer and customer films
sections.text: For The Thermal Heat Company, a plumbing and heating firm, we made a film that walks customers through what to expect on installation day, with the managing director explaining each step on camera and footage of the team at work.

sections.heading: Brand films and product photography
sections.text: For Stanton we shot a black and white brand film inside their workshop. We also photograph products, details and people at work, so your website and social media have stills that match your films.

sections.heading: How pricing works
sections.text: Every brief is different, so we quote per project. Tell us what you have in mind, where you are and when you need it, and we'll come back with a price.

faqs.question: How much does a promotional video cost?
faqs.answer: Every brief is different, so we quote per project. Get in touch with what you have in mind and we'll come back with a price.

faqs.question: Do you work with businesses outside Derbyshire?
faqs.answer: Yes. We're based in Belper, Derbyshire, and work with businesses across the UK.

faqs.question: Can you provide photos as well as video?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer product photography and stills alongside films, so your website and social media have matching images.
